task.description: Implement the validated ISS-0531 design: resolveTenantSlug returns the pinned default realm verbatim instead of stripping its prefix.

result.note: Added a DEFAULT_TENANT_REALM = 'bpm-default' constant with a comment citing tenant.ex's @default_tenant_slug and validate_default_tenant_pinning/1 as the sync-drift source of truth, and an exact-match check (if realm === DEFAULT_TENANT_REALM return realm) inserted before the existing prefix-strip line, exactly matching the design's decision table. tenant_id-priority branch and try/catch URL-parsing structure untouched. JSDoc updated. Added describe('resolveTenantSlug') with 4 cases (TC-SH05-U01..U04) covering default-realm regression, ordinary-realm regression, tenant_id priority, no-claim -> null. Genuine fail-then-pass proof: temporarily reverted the fix, TC-SH05-U01 failed as expected (expected 'default' to be 'bpm-default'), all 15 other tests still passed; re-applied fix, all 16 passed. Full check suite: type-check clean, lint clean, vitest 36 files/203 tests passed including all 16 in tokenUtils.test.ts, guards 4 files/48 tests passed including a successful production build. Scope confirmed via git diff --stat: only tokenUtils.ts and tokenUtils.test.ts changed, no backend files, no other frontend files. SECURITY-REVIEWER out of scope: frontend-only auth-slug-derivation fix, no tenant-data query/response-shaping path touched (this affects which slug the SPA requests, not what the backend returns for a given slug).
